items.title: ARC-070/MECH-321 prediction-failure SELECTIVITY: rank-based top-20% forward-PE trigger vs rate-matched yoked control, unconditional whole-episode DV (n=40)
items.note: Re-posed ARC-070/MECH-321 PREDICTION-FAILURE SELECTIVITY test, built per REE_assembly/evidence/planning/govdiag1_repose_mech321_chain_2026-08-12.md section 5 (chip-20260814-mech321-pe-selectivity-repose). NEW NUMBER, not a letter of 816: the question, the trigger readout and the control all change. GATING PRECONDITION DISCHARGED -- authored only after the section 7 ledger resolutions landed (REE_assembly a843ee6ebb, 2026-08-18, GFLAG-0038): H-vs-proxy-saturation -> confirmed; H-env-underdrives-uncertainty ratified SUPERSEDED/moot (its registry state string stays 'alive' ONLY because the schema has no 'superseded' member -- the basis field says 'READ THIS LEG AS MOOT, NOT AS OPEN'), so no formally-live leg is probed. WHAT THE SIX PRIOR RUNS (816b/816c/816d/830 x2/839) COULD NOT DO: each died at a trigger-OCCUPANCY gate with the load-bearing DV CONDITIONAL on that occupancy, which aliases NO EFFECT and NO OCCASION into one non-verdict; the natural response was to escalate the env (816->816b->816d moved off_pe_mean_worst 0.0080->0.008594->0.008675, under 0.0007 total, low_vs_steps 0 at every dose). THREE FIXES: (1) TRIGGER IS RANK-BASED -- top-PE_QUANTILE_Q=20% of rollout steps by forward-model PE ranked WITHIN the run (expanding-window quantile after a 60-tick calibration prefix), so occupancy is a DESIGN PARAMETER not a run outcome and no env harshening is needed; (2) DV IS UNCONDITIONAL whole-episode mean harm signal over ALL seeds, no screen/tiering/divergence-tick windowing; (3) CONTROL IS RATE-MATCHED -- ARM_YOKED gets ARM_PE's per-episode forced-locus count EXACTLY, seed by seed, at uniformly-drawn PE-uninformative loci. LOAD-BEARING CONTRAST IS ARM_PE vs ARM_YOKED (ARM_OFF is a manipulation check only); none of the six chain runs had a rate control -- 820's ARM_2 was a different TRIGGER at its own uncontrolled rate, and its R1 side never fired. PRE-DECLARED NULL: ARM_PE-ARM_YOKED harm delta <= 0 within 1.0 x SE over >= 40 paired seeds REFUTES ARC-070's prediction-failure-selectivity leg at this grain -- both directions are verdicts, which is the point of the re-pose. REFUSALS HONOURED (section 6): no 816e / fourth env-axis escalation; no driver keyed on region-V_s as the PREDICTION-FAILURE READOUT; no H-algorithm-axis probe as pre-registered. region_vs appears ONLY as the substrate's trigger ACTUATOR (PolicyDecomposition.evaluate() takes it caller-supplied; HippocampalModule._region_vs() is its sole source -- the V3-EXQ-904 technique); the READOUT deciding WHERE to fire is forward-model PE. NO low_vs_steps floor and NO vs_heterogeneity gate anywhere in the driver. PE LAG=1 tick, stated: e3_prediction_error is computed in post_action_update (after the action), so the trigger reads the previous tick's PE -- any same-tick form would be an oracle the agent could not have. OCCUPANCY IS A MANIPULATION CHECK, NEVER A GATE: only the trivial existential (ARM_PE/ARM_YOKED forced fires > 0, ARM_OFF decomposition exactly 0) plus an ARM-LEVEL rate match within RATE_MATCH_TOL=0.25 (arm-level because section 5e's literal quantity is |rate(ARM_PE)-rate(ARM_YOKED)|; a per-seed conjunction would let one outlier void a ~30h run -- per-seed gaps and the outside-tolerance count are reported regardless). ARM_BOUNDARY (optional 4th arm) DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT, a decision not an omission: the MECH-288 boundary detector is already live in every arm (probe seed 11: V_s silent throughout still gave 33 boundary fires -> 26 of 278 precommit evaluations decomposing), so rate-matching it would require SUPPRESSING and re-placing the natural boundary path -- a second invasive manipulation needing its own controls, +40 cells/~10h, for a contrast the design doc does not call load-bearing. decomp_n_boundary_fires is recorded per cell in EVERY arm as descriptive data for H-r1-r5-dissociable; that leg is NOT claimed answered. FIXED-LENGTH ROLLOUTS: every cell runs the full 60 ticks/episode and does NOT break on the env's done flag, matching 844/867/867a/867b/919 (919 names it _done and ignores it). Load-bearing twice: mean_harm_signal is a whole-episode harm RATE so truncating at health depletion would drop the most harmful ticks and survival-bias the DV (and break cross-readability with 919), and it guarantees every yoked locus drawn from range(steps) actually occurs so the matched count is delivered exactly. Terminations counted as mean_done_events_per_episode. A-A NULL CONTROL ON ARM_PE (strengthening over 919, which controlled on its inert OFF arm): 4 seeds x 3 replicates, all through arm_cell, must be mutually bit-identical -- ARM_PE is the arm exercising the NEW instrumentation (PE history, expanding-window quantile, injected actuator), so it is the path whose determinism needs proving. Any nonzero delta VOIDS the run. GRID: 40 measurement seeds x 3 arms + 4 A-A seeds x 3 replicates = 132 cells, 1584 episodes. Seeds are 919's 40 verbatim and in order (already excluding seed 44's known instability) so harm readings cross-read against 919 on the same substrate family. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = paired per-seed ARM_PE-minus-ARM_YOKED unconditional whole-episode mean_harm_signal delta. Neither arm has ever existed -- grep -rlE 'ARM_YOKED|ARM_PE\b' over ree-v3/experiments/ is EMPTY (2026-08-18) -- and the readout cannot be derived by reprocessing because no banked cell was produced under this manipulation; the manipulation IS the question. Not recoverable -> run. try_reuse_cell omitted (no prior mint to cite); ARM_OFF cells minted reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False). RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b) does not fire: measured 2026-08-18, ARC-070 = 0 braking autopsies, MECH-321 = 1 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-867_2026-08-02), both under the threshold of 2; and this is a redesign of a different mechanism under a new number, not a lettered re-test. SUBSTRATE-PATH GATE (2.5c): one open substrate_queue entry overlaps (mech203-valence-pool-admissibility, ree_core/agent.py::update_harm_salience + latent/stack.py::HarmEncoder) with severity UNSET, so it does not block -- recorded here and in the manifest because HarmEncoder is upstream of this run's DV. ETHICS PREFLIGHT (2.6): all involvement flags false, decision allow -- standard V3, pre-ethical instrumentation only (SENT-0). SMOKE PASS (--dry-run, 3 measurement seeds + 1 A-A seed, reduced 3-episode x 30-step schedule): pe_forced_min=8 and yoked_forced_min=8 (both > 0), off_decomposed_max=0 (structural zero holds), pe_var_min=7.41e-08 (ranking signal non-degenerate), arm_rel_gap=0.0562 vs tol 0.25, A-A all 3 replicates bit-identical (max_abs_delta 0.0), and -- the assertion that matters most -- arms_differ_on=3/3 seeds, i.e. placing the SAME amount of decomposition at different loci does change behaviour, so the load-bearing contrast is not structurally vacuous. validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings across all 26 lints. ID NOTE: originally authored as V3-EXQ-937; renumbered to 938 after a concurrent session landed 937/937a (MECH-449) on origin/main mid-authoring. OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED -- STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMED: queued from ree-cloud-5, which has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env, so POST /queue/add could not be issued. Under Phase 3 the runners read the coordinator DB, not this file, so this entry is NOT yet runnable: a coordinator-capable box must POST it (read the item from the landing commit, not the working tree). Estimated ~30h: 132 cells vs 919's 88 at the same 12x60 schedule and 919's measured 1260 min. Routed to a cloud worker (any), not the Mac.
